episodes.title: Help Me
episodes.summary: It is 2019, most of humanity has turned into vampires. Axel MIller guards a facility where a mysterious woman called Vanessa is in some kind of coma. She awakes when vampires are attacking the facility, she seems to be special and may hold the key to save the world.

episodes.title: Seen You
episodes.summary: In flashback, we see events leading up to 'The Rising.' Vanessa is attacked and left for dead by an intruder. When Doc discovers anomalies in Vanessa's bloodwork, Axel and the marines come to retrieve the body, only to become marooned in the hospital when 'The Rising' erupts outside the building.

episodes.title: Stay Inside
episodes.summary: When the hospital's power source is damaged, Vanessa and the survivors only have three hours of reserve power for the UV lights - the only thing keeping the vampires at bay. While Vanessa and Axel head into the ruins of Seattle to scavenge parts, the others are left to fight: against both vampires and amongst themselves.

episodes.title: Coming Back
episodes.summary: Vanessa and Mohamad head into the vampire-controlled streets in search of Vanessa's daughter; Cynthia is found dead at the hospital, and Doc thinks her apparent suicide is actually a deliberate murder; Vanessa is captured by vampires.

episodes.title: Fear Her
episodes.summary: Vanessa, now in the clutches of Julius and his vampire brood, is forced to demonstrate her powers; the refugees discover a serial killer among the residents, and plot to wrestle control from Axel.

episodes.title: Nothing Matters
episodes.summary: Vanessa and Susan are chased by mutated feral vampires in the sewers, arriving back at the hospital only after a hostile takeover.

episodes.title: For Me
episodes.summary: Vanessa and Axel lead the hospital's last stand against a siege by Julius and his vampire soldiers; Dmitri's arrival with his vampire "Death Squad" reveals a possible civil war brewing among the two vampire factions.

episodes.title: Little Thing
episodes.summary: Axel leads the surviving members of their group towards his old military base for shelter but finds it abandoned and in disrepair. With vampires closing in all around them, Axel decides they need a safer refuge and decides to go underground. Separated from Vanessa and the group, Mohamad tries to catch up while navigating hostile territory.

episodes.title: Help Out
episodes.summary: The group is trapped inside 'The Farm' - an underground lab for military experiments - and Vanessa discovers that Axel has been hiding a secret from her that concerns her past. Outside, Mohamad befriends a beautiful girl who doesn't fear vampires. Meanwhile, Rebecca makes a calculated play against the Resistance leadership.

episodes.title: Stay Away
episodes.summary: Still reeling from the dire events of 'The Farm', Vanessa and the group find refuge among a band of humans who have bargained with vampires for peace. Their leader, however, appears to be hiding a terrible secret. Meanwhile, the true serial killer among Vanessa's group is finally revealed.

episodes.title: Last Time
episodes.summary: There are glimmers of hope and reasons for grief when Vanessa and the group take shelter at Susan's family farm. With the serial killer finally outed, Vanessa and Mohamad take drastic action against him. Meanwhile, Rebecca's latest experiment to create Daywalkers fails; and Dmitri's patience grows thin.

episodes.title: He's Coming
episodes.summary: Vanessa and Mohamad find themselves in a dangerous game of cat-and-mouse against Sam while heading to a vampire-controlled camp; Sheema discovers a secret that could bring down a cell of the Resistance; Julius takes a meeting with Dmitri.

episodes.title: It Begins
episodes.summary: Now in Dmitri and Rebecca's clutches, Vanessa learns secrets from her past and finds herself at a crossroads; Flesh and the Resistance accelerate their timeline to rescue Vanessa; Mohamad and Sheema finally come to blows over their allegiances.

episodes.title: Began Again
episodes.summary: Vanessa and Mohamad search for Dylan as Dmitri's citadel crumbles around them; Flesh acquires an unexpected ally in one of the Resistance Fighters; Taka clashes with the Vampire Elite.

episodes.title: In Redemption
episodes.summary: Vanessa fights to get her daughter out of the citadel; Dmitri and Antanasia hatch a plot to stop Vanessa; Mohamad risks his life to save Vanessa and Dylan.

episodes.title: Love Bites
episodes.summary: Vanessa makes a horrific decision to save her daughter; Axel and a former ally struggle to survive in the wild; a group of juvenile delinquents come face to face with a sadistic vampire.

episodes.title: A Home
episodes.summary: Vanessa encounters a group of vampires whose gruesome methods bring savagery to a new level; the Juvenile Delinquents continue their game of cat-and-mouse with Sam and that has deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Save Yourself
episodes.summary: Vanessa faces off against Sam in a bloody showdown; Dmitri hears news that sends him on a warpath after Vanessa; Flesh, Mohamad and Lucky take desperate steps to save their lives.

episodes.title: Veritas Vincit
episodes.summary: Vanessa's past rushes back to confront her in an unexpected way; a secret is revealed that Doc has been protecting; in a bid to bolster his power, Dmitri sends Scab on an impossible mission.

episodes.title: Everything Changes
episodes.summary: Vanessa faces off with Dmitri; Axel fights against becoming a full-fledged vampire; Sam tracks Mohamad, Flesh and Lucky; Scab tries to enlist a fierce group of vampires to join Dmitri.

episodes.title: Big Mama
episodes.summary: As the group struggles with the disappearance of one of its own, they accept sanctuary in a town run by its Sheriff and his troops; Dmitri inches closer to achieving his darkest goal.

episodes.title: Wakey, Wakey
episodes.summary: A tense standoff between law enforcement and the survivors erupts into a bloodbath; in a bid to evade a vicious breed of vampire, Axel and Scarlett find themselves hunted like prey.

episodes.title: Base Pair
episodes.summary: A mystery unravels when an organization fighting to find a cure for vampirism enlists the help of someone in the group; old loyalties are put to the test with deadly results.

episodes.title: Be True
episodes.summary: Sam's and Mohamad's shared past comes back to haunt them in more ways than one. At a secluded campsite in the woods, friendships both old and new are put through a baptism by fire.

episodes.title: Crooked Falls
episodes.summary: While the rest of the group fight for survival, Axel and Scarlett defend a mountain stronghold against a relentless foe; Doc makes a medical discovery that could change everything.

episodes.title: Black Days
episodes.summary: At a mountain stronghold, secrets of the Van Helsing family are unearthed and the true face of evil is exposed; a climactic battle between humans and vampires leaves humanity's fate in question.

episodes.title: Fresh Tendrils
episodes.summary: Vanessa is once again resurrected and must confront her family's legacy; Axel, Scarlett and the others fend off Blak Tek's forces, who hope to add Scarlett to their list of lab rats.

episodes.title: Super Unknown
episodes.summary: To find its totem, the First Elder brings Vanessa, Scarlett and Axel to an abandoned insane asylum protected by powerful vampires, where they discover the legacy of a long dead Van Helsing relative.

episodes.title: I Awake
episodes.summary: Vanessa relives the memories of her ancestor, Lily Van Helsing, in Colonial Hong Kong; there, she learns to control her dark side and fights the B'ah, the second vampire Elder.

episodes.title: Rusty Cage
episodes.summary: Sam comes to realize his dark destiny and tries to groom Mohamad to be a worthy partner. Scab and Ivory are bestowed Daywalker powers and return home to find the Sisterhood in ruins.

episodes.title: Pretty Noose
episodes.summary: In San Francisco, Vanessa, Scarlett and Axel find and battle against the Second Elder's forces; in Denver, Flesh, Doc, Julius and Jolene rejoin American civilization as best they can.

episodes.title: Like Suicide
episodes.summary: Vanessa has a final showdown with the Second Elder in San Francisco; in Denver, Flesh, Doc, Julius and Jolene learn that even in a Safe-Zone, life isn't easy.

episodes.title: Hunted Down
episodes.summary: Sam moves closer to his destiny while Mohamad tries to free himself from imprisonment. Axel escorts San Francisco survivors to Denver. Ivory and Scab take control of the Daywalker horde.

episodes.title: Crooked Steps
episodes.summary: On a distant island, Vanessa and Scarlett battle the Third Elder. Vanessa makes a choice about her path forward, one that Scarlett does not agree with.

episodes.title: Loud Love
episodes.summary: Doc and Jolene clash with Denver authorities over the repellent. Flesh chooses to face his past. Axel struggles with leaving Scarlett behind. Ivory and the Sisterhood infiltrate Denver.

episodes.title: Outside World
episodes.summary: Vanessa, trapped in an abandoned slaughterhouse, wrestles between the light and dark sides of her own self before she can move forward on her path to find the Final Elder.

episodes.title: Been Away
episodes.summary: In his hometown, Axel fights both his tragic past and a vicious pack of Daywalkers; Sam can't find Mohamad and takes his anger out on Chad and Mike.

episodes.title: Christ Pose
episodes.summary: Scarlett is reunited with Axel but he is badly injured before they can find Vanessa; a mysterious man helps them find their way; Flesh and Jolene are fugitives on the run from Blaktek.

episodes.title: Birth Ritual
episodes.summary: Vanessa and Sam face off to find the Last Elder, with Scarlett, Axel and Mohamad caught in the crossfire; Julius fights the Sisterhood; Doc unlocks the secrets in the Dark One's blood.

episodes.title: Dark Destiny
episodes.summary: With the amulet in hand, Vanessa and Lily escape from Elder Sam and return to the real world.

episodes.title: Dark Ties
episodes.summary: After Violet's attack, Julius and Doc find information that Hansen will do anything to keep quiet.

episodes.title: Love Less
episodes.summary: A grieving and aimless Axel rescues an enigmatic Max, who returns the favor with a job offer.

episodes.title: Broken Promises
episodes.summary: After an epic battle, Axel reconciles with Vanessa and comes to terms with the death of Scarlett.

episodes.title: Liberty or Death
episodes.summary: Sam and the Brides arrive at Fort Collins, where Hansen reveals a secret for raising the Dark One.

episodes.title: Miles and Miles
episodes.summary: In an infested desert, Flesh and Axel chase a crazed Max, who has held Jennifer and Owen hostage.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis
episodes.summary: Three generations of Van Helsings come together before a showdown with Elder Sam and the Oracle.

episodes.title: The Prism
episodes.summary: 3 Pages are key to raising or destroying the Dark One, but only Hansen knows where they are hidden.

episodes.title: No "I" In Team
episodes.summary: In a flashback to the Rising, Jack and her archers battle vampires that are taking over the city.

episodes.title: Together Forever
episodes.summary: After Violet is taken hostage by a sadistic ringmaster, she is forced to go head-to-head with various opponents if she wants to escape the gladiator arena.

episodes.title: All Apologies
episodes.summary: Now that Violet knows where the 3 Pages are, she returns to Fort Collins with Axel and Julius.

episodes.title: Three Pages
episodes.summary: As the sisters prepare to open the portal to the Dark One, Hansen makes the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: The Beholder
episodes.summary: The President and Ivory try to decipher what really happened in the Dark Realm.

episodes.title: Past Tense
episodes.summary: After waking in the Dark Realm, Jack is sent through a portal with only the words "Kill the Dark One" to guide her. Jack discovers some familiar faces as she hunts for the Dark One.

episodes.title: Old Friends
episodes.summary: Jack joins forces with her once sworn enemy who reveals a dangerous weapon that will help the Van Helsings kill the Dark One, but the consequences of using this weapon are dire.

episodes.title: Lumina Intunecata
episodes.summary: Jack faces off against the Dark One with a new ally whose allegiances may not be trusted.

episodes.title: State of the Union
episodes.summary: Axel and Julius awaken in the Sunshine Unit, where a familiar face reveals the truth about their injuries; at Fort Collins, Violet and Ivory must convince their captors they are not traitors.

episodes.title: Sisterhunt
episodes.summary: Violet and Ivory go on the run from Fort Collins with the now vulnerable Sisterhood; Violet risks everything to keep the amulet out of The Dark One's hands.

episodes.title: Carpe Noctis
episodes.summary: Axel and Julius encounter a significant person from Julius' past in their pursuit of Van Helsing, and Julius realizes she may not be who he thought she was.

episodes.title: Graveyard Smash
episodes.summary: As Axel and Julius continue their search for the Van Helsings, Violet and Ivory try to decipher a new clue all the while staying one step ahead of the Dark One.

episodes.title: Deep Trouble
episodes.summary: Axel, Violet, Jack and Ivory are on their way to D.C. when an attack from the military leads them to take cover in an abandoned mine, but the mine may not be as safe as they think.

episodes.title: The Doorway
episodes.summary: Vanessa wills Axel into the Dark Realm, where they both discover secrets of their past that may help them in the future.

episodes.title: E Pluribus Unum
episodes.summary: Axel and Violet inadvertently save an important figure from America's past who could help turn the tide in their fight against the Dark One.

episodes.title: Undercover Mother
episodes.summary: As the Dark One yearns to release her full power upon the Real World her plans are interrupted by a strange visitor to the White House.

episodes.title: The Voices
episodes.summary: Vanessa, Axel, Jack, Violet and Ivory finally reunite in the real world and begin their plan to take down The Dark One.

episodes.title: Novissima Solis
episodes.summary: Vanessa, Violet and Jack face off with The Dark One in the ultimate battle to save humanity.
